### Lumentum Experts to Share Insights at ECOC 2026


September 15, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/377324469/files/doc_news/Lumentum-Experts-to-Share-Insights-at-ECOC-2026-2026.pdf)


*Lumentum thought leaders to discuss innovations in AI interconnects, silicon photonics, VCSELs, and optical networking*


SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Lumentum, a global leader in optical and photonic technology, today announced its speaker line-up at the 2026 European Conference on Optical Communications ([ECOC](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lumentum.com%2Fen%2Fevents%2Fecoc-2026&esheet=54604269&newsitemid=20260915270131&lan=en-US&anchor=ECOC&index=1&md5=351d7121343f7a7419947b8ac72009e4) ) in Málaga, Spain. The event will be held from September 20 – 24 at the Trade Fair and Congress Center of Málaga. Visit Lumentum stand #2050.


- [Can Fast Narrow Channels Keep Rising Without Limit or Will Slow and Wide Become the Winner?](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fecoc2026.org%2Fecoc2026%2Fprogramme%2Fworkshops&esheet=54604269&newsitemid=20260915270131&lan=en-US&anchor=Can+Fast+Narrow+Channels+Keep+Rising+Without+Limit+or+Will+Slow+and+Wide+Become+the+Winner%3F&index=2&md5=4f8affbc18273a851cc9f7163927b01b)

**About Lumentum**


Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE) is a global leader in optical and photonic technologies that power the networks and infrastructure behind AI, cloud computing, and next-generation communications. Built on decades of photonics innovation, Lumentum delivers high-performance lasers, modules, and optical subsystems that enable scalable, energy-efficient data center connectivity, advanced telecom networks, industrial manufacturing, and sensing applications. Headquartered in San Jose, California, the company operates R&D, manufacturing, and sales facilities worldwide. Learn more at[www.lumentum.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.lumentum.com&esheet=54604269&newsitemid=20260915270131&lan=en-US&anchor=www.lumentum.com&index=9&md5=45adb145744813bd7046de2a63eb6686) .
